/bin/sh -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3

connection = sqlite3.connect('inventory.db')
print(connection.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check;').fetchone()[0])
connection.close()
PY

/bin/sh -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3

connection = sqlite3.connect('inventory.db')
connection.execute('CREATE TABLE _initialize_database (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)')
connection.commit()
connection.execute('DROP TABLE _initialize_database')
connection.commit()
print('integrity_check:', connection.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check;').fetchone()[0])
connection.close()
PY
ls -l inventory.db && file inventory.db && head -c 16 inventory.db | od -An -tc"
